name: plugin-redoc
description: Generates a single-file HTML page from your OpenAPI spec with Redoc, rebuilt on every Kubb run so the docs match the spec your code comes from.

options.label: Output Path
options.description: Path of the generated HTML file. End it in .html.

options.label: Banner
options.description: Text added at the top of every generated file

options.label: Footer
options.description: Text added at the end of every generated file
